reviews.title: Really?
reviews.text: You might want to make it so that a brand new user to your app does not get thrown into an ad right away that you can’t get out of. I deleted it immediately.

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: Over all I do not think this is a great game good idea but really hard to play and too many adds

reviews.title: This is a scam, uninstalled as soon I saw a premium
reviews.text: This app is built to take your money for a pointless subscription because if you don’t, you’ll barely get to play songs YOU wanted to play and stuck with so many ads. Just go find songs you want to cover on Youtube or try to cover it yourself instead of spending a penny on this.
